# Instructions for LLMs using event-source-plus

**WARNING:** The `event-source-plus` library has a DIFFERENT API than the native browser `EventSource` class. Do NOT assume they share the same properties or methods.

## Key Differences

1.  **Initialization**:
    Use `new EventSourcePlus(url, options)` instead of `new EventSource(url)`. The options object accepts standard `fetch` options (like `method`, `headers`, `body`).
2.  **Listening to Events**:
    Do NOT use `.onmessage`, `.addEventListener()`, or `.onerror`.
    Instead, use the `listen()` method and pass an object with hooks (`onMessage`, `onRequest`, `onRequestError`, `onResponse`, `onResponseError`).
    ```typescript
    const eventSource = new EventSourcePlus("https://example.com");
    const controller = eventSource.listen({
        onMessage(message, context) {
            console.log(message.data);
            // message is of type SseMessage: { id?: string; event: string; data: string; retry?: number; }
        },
        onResponseError({ response }) {
            console.error(response.status);
        },
    });
    ```
3.  **Controllers & Closing the Connection**:
    The `.listen()` method returns an `EventSourceController` which provides `.abort()`, `.reconnect()`, and `.onAbort()`.
    Do NOT use `eventSource.close()`. Use `controller.abort()` instead.

## Full Example

```typescript
import { EventSourcePlus } from "event-source-plus";

const eventSource = new EventSourcePlus("https://api.example.com/stream", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        Authorization: "Bearer token",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: "hello" }),
    retryStrategy: "on-error", // extremely useful for LLM text streams
});

const controller = eventSource.listen({
    onMessage(message) {
        if (message.data === "[DONE]") {
            controller.abort();
            return;
        }
        const data = JSON.parse(message.data);
        console.log(data.text);
    },
    onRequestError({ error }) {
        console.error("Request Failed:", error);
    },
});
```
